channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold holds steady as hawkish Fed bets counter Israel-Iran truce and weaker USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on the previous day's late recovery from the $4,267-$4,268 region, or the lowest level since March 23, and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds gains against Japanese Yen as China’s Trade Balance rises more than expected
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross posts modest gains near 112.90 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. A larger-than-expected China trade surplus provides some support to the China-proxy Australian Dollar (AUD). Markets are on high alert for foreign exchange intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains calm despite strong China Trade Balance data
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) remains steady against its major currency peers, trading flat around 0.7050 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday. The Aussie pair consolidates even as the Chinese Trade Balance data for May has come in stronger than expected.

item.title: Swiss Franc steadies as easing safe-haven demand weighs on US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF inches lower after two days of gains, trading around 0.7970 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair has depreciated alongside a declining US Dollar (USD) following a breakthrough agreement between Iran and Israel to halt mutual attacks.

item.title: China’s Trade Surplus widens in May: What CNY723.98B Trade Balance means for the Australian Dollar
item.description: China's Trade Balance for May, in Chinese Yuan (CNY) terms, arrived at CNY723.98 billion, widening from the previous figure of CNY585.69 billion.

item.title: Canadian Dollar bounces off late March low vs softer USD; weak Oil prices cap gains
item.description: The USD/CAD pair edges lower during the Asian session on Tuesday, eroding part of the previous day's gains to its highest level since late March. Spot prices, however, lack follow-through selling and currently trade just below mid-1.3900s, down less than 0.05% for the day.

item.title: United States Dollar Index declines as Iran, Israel agree to halt strikes
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is remaining subdued for the second successive day and trading around 100.00 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD inches lower to near $68.00 amid rising Fed rate hike bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) pares its recent gains from the previous day, trading around $67.90 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Uncertainty in the Middle East and rising bets on a United States (US) interest rate hike continue to keep Silver on the defensive.

item.title: British Pound consolidates around mid-1.3300s vs USD; upside potential seems limited
item.description: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest bounce from the 1.3300 neighborhood, or over a three-week low, and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen softens despite fresh currency intervention threats
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades in positive territory around 160.20 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. Escalation in the Middle East continues to boost the US Dollar (USD) against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8147 vs. 6.8198 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Tuesday at 6.8147 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8198 and 6.7809 Reuters estimate.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar eases ahead of China Trade Balance data
item.description: NZD/USD loses ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5800 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair declines as the US Dollar (USD) holds ground amid uncertainty surrounding the Middle East ceasefire.

item.title: Australian Dollar hangs near two-month low vs USD ahead of China's Trade Balance data
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest bounce from its lowest level since April 13 and drifts lower during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Stance unchanged, prepare for decisive measures
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday that the stance is unchanged and authorities are prepared for decisive measures.

item.title: WTI edges lower to near $89.50 as Iran, Israel agree to halt attacks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price edges lower after registering over 1% losses in the previous day, trading around $89.40 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Japan's Kiuchi hopes BoJ will keep cooperating with government on fighting deflation
item.description: Japan's Economy Minister, Minoru Kiuchi, said on Tuesday that long-term rates are determined by markets through diverse factors, including supply-demand and steady economic recovery.

item.title: Euro weakens below 1.1550 on Middle East uncertainty ahead of ECB rate decision
item.description: The EUR/USD pair loses traction to around 1.1530 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday, pressured by uncertainty in the Middle East. Traders await the release of the US May Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data later on Wednesday for fresh impetus.

item.title: Israel’s Netanyahu says war with Iran, Hezbollah isn’t over after Tehran says it’s halting strikes
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the war against Iran and its Lebanon-based proxy Hezbollah “has not yet ended,” though he insisted both are weaker than ever, CNBC reported on Monday.

item.title: Gold edges lower below $4,350 as Fed rate hike expectations grow
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades with mild losses around $4,325 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal remains on the defensive near its lowest since March 24 amid uncertainty in the Middle East and rising bets of a US interest rate hike.

item.title: The British Pound Sterling has the best rate in the G7 and the chart of a laggard
item.description: Pound Sterling is supposed to be the high-carry name in the G7, and for most of this year that logic held.

item.title: Japanese Yen ignores every reason it has to strengthen
item.description: There is a strange disconnect running through the Japanese Yen right now, and USD/JPY parked just above 160.00 captures it perfectly.

item.title: South Korean Won: Policy support and equity rebalancing – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad highlights that the Korean Won (KRW) has outperformed peers after authorities intensified stabilization efforts. Measures include new FX rules, tighter oversight of offshore derivatives and FX hedging by the National Pension Service.

item.title: Australian Dollar leans on a China prop that's quietly buckling
item.description: The Australian Dollar spent Monday trying to talk itself into a recovery, and the tape was not buying it.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Neutral within 6.7620–6.7980 band versus US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann observe that USD/CNH edged higher toward 6.79 but upward momentum remains limited. For the day, they expect consolidation in a 6.7800–6.7950 range.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Trapped between key SMAs, bulls eye 214.00
item.description: The GBP/JPY trims some of its earlier losses, turns nearly flat during the day at around 213.60, and is modestly down 0.09% amid a mixed market mood, an indication of cautious trading amid the ongoing environment.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Inverted head-and-shoulders forms, eyes on 0.80
item.description: The USD/CHF pair advances some 0.30% on Monday, as an inverted head-and-shoulders chart pattern is confirmed, along with price action leaving the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) below the current spot price. At the time of writing, the pair trades near 0.7981.

item.title: Asia FX: Oil and Fed backdrop weigh on KRW, IDR – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong notes that higher Oil prices and a firmer United States (US) policy outlook are pressuring Asia FX, particularly the Korean Won (KRW) and Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).

item.title: Gold holds flat as US CPI risk offsets ceasefire optimism
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price is virtually unchanged on Monday as market mood improves due to Iran-Israel halting attacks, even though last Friday’s Nonfarm Payroll figures showed the solidness of the labor market, clearing the way for the Federal Reserve (Fed) to focus on inflation.

item.title: South Korean Won: Policy support tempers KRW losses – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Hardman links a sharp correction in South Korean AI‑heavy equities to potential pressure on the Korean Won.

item.title: Forex Today: Markets assess Japanese GDP as ECB decision looms
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) trades with a cautious tone near the 100.00 region as investors balance resilient United States (US) economic data against improving global risk sentiment following reports that Iran has ended its military operations against Israel.
